issues.reason: The text claims widespread-ness only within Persia, so the unrestricted (Past (KindProperty corruption widespread)) asserts more than the text states, and the separate LocatedIn atom cannot bind the restriction to it.

LocatedIn is specified for where a THING (an entity) is — the head IS the entity-vs-event/kind distinction — so a bare kind in its first slot is ill-typed, and the untensed standing assertion is not what the sentence states.
(Inheritance discipline lax) predicates laxness of discipline at large while the subject is the specific "discipline in the army" — an over-assertion.
Same ill-typing (a kind in LocatedIn's entity slot), and an army is an organization, not a containing place.

gaps_confirmed: locative/restrictive PP scoping a kind-level or mass-noun property claim — nothing decides between ConditionalProperty's condition slot, a location atom, or a restricted witness
abstract mass-noun subject of a copular clause (corruption, discipline) — no rule covers a bare or post-modified mass noun in subject position
repair_summary: Clause A: replaced the unrestricted KindProperty plus LocatedIn pair with (Past (ConditionalProperty corruption widespread persia)), the "Trailers are permitted on the causeway" locative-restriction precedent, keeping the parser's (1.0 0.9). Clause B: minted the restricted-portion witness sk_discipline_1 — (Member sk_discipline_1 discipline) plus the entity-attached surface preposition (In sk_discipline_1 sk_army_1) per the wool-from-Calderwick precedent — replacing the ill-typed LocatedIn. Moved the lax predication and its Degree atom onto that witness as Past-wrapped individual facts at the default (STV 1.0 0.99).
notes: Widespread fails the could-one-individual test, so a witness route was barred for clause A and it stays kind-level with the restriction in the condition slot; lax is an ordinary individual-level adjective, so clause B takes the witness route. The Degree atom had to follow its subject so no over-asserting kind-level atom remains, which also resolves the reviewer's note about its odd (0.9 0.9).
